import FreeCAD
import Part
import PartDesign

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("BoxModel")

# Create a Part Design Body
body = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Body")

# Create a Part Design Pad (which will contain the box)
pad = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Pad", "Pad")

# Create a sketch for the base rectangle
sketch = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch")

# Add the sketch to the body
body.addObject(sketch.Name)

# Define the sketch geometry: rectangle 36mm x 24mm
# Place the rectangle with one corner at origin
sketch.mapMode = 'FlatFace'
sketch.MapReversed = False
sketch.AttachmentOffset = FreeCAD.Matrix()

# Add geometric constraints for a rectangle 36x24
# Using four lines forming a rectangle
# Line 1: from (0,0) to (36,0)
# Line 2: from (36,0) to (36,24)
# Line 3: from (36,24) to (0,24)
# Line 4: from (0,24) to (0,0)

# Add vertices and lines
sketch.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(36, 0, 0)), False)
sketch.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(36, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(36, 24, 0)), False)
sketch.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(36, 24, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 24, 0)), False)
sketch.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 24, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0)), False)

# Constrain the sketch - make it closed and add dimensions
# Constraint indices: 0,1,2,3 are the line geometries
# First constraint: horizontal dimension of 36 on bottom edge (line 0)
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('HorizontalLength', 0, 36.0))
# Second constraint: vertical dimension of 24 on right edge (line 1)
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('VerticalLength', 1, 24.0))

# Set the sketch to be in XY plane
sketch.Placement = FreeCAD.Placement(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Rotation(0, 0, 0, 1))

# Now set up the pad to extrude by 10mm
pad.Sketch = sketch
pad.Length = 10.0
pad.Mode = 0  # Dimension mode

# Compute the document
doc.recompute()

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

print("Document saved successfully!")
print(f"Body: {body.Name}")
print(f"Pad: {pad.Name}")
print(f"Sketch: {sketch.Name}")
EOF

content: Now I have a Body and a Pad, but the Pad doesn't have a sketch yet. The task requires an "additive box" which in Part Design terms is typically a Pad feature with a rectangular sketch. Let me try to properly configure the Pad with dimensions:

import FreeCAD
import Part
import Sketcher
import PartDesign

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("BoxModel")

# First create Part Design Body
body = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Body")
print(f"Created body: {body.Name}")

# Compute
doc.recompute()

# Try creating a Pad directly - this is the additive feature in Part Design
pad = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Pad", "Pad")
print(f"Created pad: {pad.Name}")

# Set pad properties - Length for extrusion height
pad.Length = 10.0
print(f"Set pad length to {pad.Length}")

# Compute
doc.recompute()

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

print("Document saved successfully!")
EOF
